image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a sliced meatloaf on a white plate. The image focuses on the texture of the cut surface, showing ground meat mixed with visible chunks of onion or breadcrumbs. The top crust is browned and appears to have a glossy, reddish glaze. A second slice is partially visible in the background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottom edge of the foreground slice blends slightly indistinctly into the plate/shadow area, lacking a perfectly sharp contact shadow, which is a common subtle artifact in food generation.

To ensure the slices are topologically sound entities without melting into the plate or each other.

focus_areas: Texture realism of ground meat vs. AI smearing

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'grease' highlights on the meat surface. AI often fails to render the specific specular highlights of fat/oil correctly, making them look like plastic or matte paint. Also, verify if the internal chunks (onions) have a coherent structure or if they dissolve into noise at their edges.
